# KAUTUSANG BAYAN No. 12, Series of 2003

**ORDINANCE PROHIBITING CATCHING AND SELLING OF ALIMANGO, ALIMASAG AND HIPON WITH SEMILYA (ITLOG)**

## Summary

This ordinance prohibits catching and selling Alimango, Alimasag and Hipon with semilya (itlog) in the waters of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. Violators will be fined or imprisoned. The ordinance aims to protect the marine resources of the municipality.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Prohibits catching Alimango, Alimasag at Hipon na may Semilya (itlog) in the waters of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
2.  **Section 2.** Prohibits selling Alimango, Alimasag at Hipon na may Semilya (itlog) in the market, talipapa or any semilya (itlog) in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
3.  **Section 3.** Violators will be fined One Thousand Pesos (₱1,000.00) to Two Thousand Five Hundred Pesos (₱2,500.00) or imprisonment of not less than one (1) month.
4.  **Section 4.** The Municipal Agriculturist, Department of National Police, Bantay-Dagat (FLET), Punong Barangay and Barangay Tanod of Bigkis Lakas are responsible for the implementation of this ordinance.
5.  **Section 5.** All those apprehended in Section 4 will be given an incentive equivalent to fifty percent (50%) of all the fines collected as a result of their efforts in implementing this ordinance.
6.  **Section 6.** This Ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after posting in conspicuous places in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
